```{r printfxn, include=FALSE}

# functions ####
# interactive table (used when the report is downloaded) - DT::datatable()
printTable <- function(DT, pageLength = 7,
                       numericColNames = NULL, numRound = 3,
                       scrollXOpt = FALSE, colNames = NULL, autoWidthOpt = FALSE, ...) {

  DT <- data.frame(lapply(X = DT,
                          FUN = function(x) {
                            if (is.numeric(x)) {
                              round(x, numRound)
                            } else {
                              x
                            }
                          }))

  table <- DT::datatable(data = DT,
                         colnames = colNames,
                         filter = "top",
                         options = list(autoWidth = autoWidthOpt,
                                        dom = 'l<<t>pB>',
                                        buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'print'),
                                        pageLength = pageLength,
                                        searchHighlight = TRUE,
                                        lengthMenu = c(7, 14, 21, 28, 35),
                                        scrollX = scrollXOpt),
                         extensions = 'Buttons',
                         rownames = FALSE,
                         ...)
  if (length(numericColNames) > 0) {
    table <- table %>% DT::formatRound(columns = numericColNames, digits = numRound)
  }

  table
}

# showTable: picks the right rendering engine.
# - When the report is downloaded (params exists) -> interactive DT widget.
# - When shown inline in the app (plain knit) -> static HTML table (kable),
#   which renders reliably through markdownToHTML and inherits the app styling.

showTable <- function(df, colNames = NULL) {
  if (download) {
    printTable(df, autoWidthOpt = TRUE, scrollXOpt = TRUE, colNames = colNames,
               numericColNames = names(which(vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1)))), numRound = 4)
  } else {
   # df2 <- df
  #  numCols <- vapply(df2, is.numeric, logical(1))
  #  df2[numCols] <- lapply(df2[numCols], function(x) round(x, 4))
  #  if (is.null(colNames)) colNames <- colnames(df2)
  #  knitr::kable(df2, format = "html", col.names = colNames,
  #               table.attr = 'class="table table-striped" style="width:auto;"')
      DT::renderDT(printTable(df, autoWidthOpt = TRUE, scrollXOpt = TRUE, colNames = colNames,
               numericColNames = names(which(vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1)))), numRound = 4)
               )
    }
}

# helper: last analysisId for a given QA module, or NULL if it was not run
lastIdForModule <- function(result, moduleName) {
  if (is.null(result) || is.null(result$status)) return(NULL)
  ids <- result$status[result$status$module == moduleName, "analysisId"]
  if (length(ids) == 0) return(NULL)
  ids[length(ids)]
}
```

```{r loaddata, include=FALSE}

# TRUE only when the document is produced via rmarkdown::render (download),
# in which case `params` is created in the knit environment.
download <- "params" %in% ls()

# Load the single shared analysis object saved by the Experimental Design module.
# The object is named `result` and carries the status/modifications/modeling for
# all three QA steps (qaMissing, qaConsistency, qaExpDesign).
result <- NULL
suppressWarnings(tryCatch({
  candidatePaths <- c(file.path(tempdir(), "resultQaPhenoDashboard.RData"),
                      "./outputs/resultQaPhenoDashboard.RData",
                      "data/resultQaPhenoDashboard.RData",
                      "resultQaPhenoDashboard.RData")
  hit <- candidatePaths[which(file.exists(candidatePaths))[1]]
  if (length(hit) == 1 && !is.na(hit)) load(hit)
}, error = function(e) {
  shinyjs::hide()
}))
```

This report consolidates the three Phenotype QA/QC steps into a single dashboard. Each section is filled only if the corresponding step has been executed and saved into the analysis object.

<p>&nbsp;</p>

### 1. Missingness

```{r}
idMiss <- lastIdForModule(result, "qaMissing")
dfMiss <- NULL
if (!is.null(result) && !is.null(idMiss) && !is.null(result$modeling)) {
  dfMiss <- result$modeling[result$modeling$module == "qaMissing" &
                              result$modeling$analysisId == idMiss,
                            c("parameter", "value"), drop = FALSE]
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
if (is.null(result) || is.null(idMiss)) {
  cat("_The Missingness step has not been run for this analysis object._")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(dfMiss) && nrow(dfMiss) > 0) {
  showTable(dfMiss, colNames = c("Decision", "Value"))
}
```

<p>&nbsp;</p>

### 2. Data consistency

```{r}
idCons    <- lastIdForModule(result, "qaConsistency")
modelCons <- NULL
modCons   <- NULL
if (!is.null(result) && !is.null(idCons)) {
  if (!is.null(result$modeling)) {
    modelCons <- result$modeling[result$modeling$module == "qaConsistency" &
                                   result$modeling$analysisId == idCons, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (!is.null(result$modifications$pheno)) {
    modCons <- result$modifications$pheno[result$modifications$pheno$module == "qaConsistency" &
                                            result$modifications$pheno$analysisId == idCons, , drop = FALSE]
  }
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
if (is.null(result) || is.null(idCons)) {
  cat("_The Data Consistency step has not been run for this analysis object._")
} else {
  cat("#### Ranges and rules applied")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(modelCons) && nrow(modelCons) > 0) {
  showTable(modelCons)
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(idCons)) cat("#### Tagged impossible values (modifications)")
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(modCons) && nrow(modCons) > 0) {
  showTable(modCons)
}
```

<p>&nbsp;</p>

### 3. Experimental design

The table below lists the environments that will be removed and the reason(s) detected: plot / block / replication conflicts, connectivity, or manual selection. This stamp also carries the Missingness and Consistency modifications, so it can be used on its own in the next step.

```{r}
idExp  <- lastIdForModule(result, "qaExpDesign")
sumExp <- NULL
if (!is.null(result) && !is.null(idExp) && !is.null(result$modeling)) {
  sumExp <- result$modeling[result$modeling$module == "qaExpDesign" &
                              result$modeling$analysisId == idExp &
                              result$modeling$parameter == "dropEnvironment",
                            c("environment", "value"), drop = FALSE]
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
if (is.null(result) || is.null(idExp)) {
  cat("_The Experimental Design step has not been run for this analysis object._")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(sumExp) && nrow(sumExp) > 0) {
  showTable(sumExp, colNames = c("Environment", "Reason to remove"))
} else if (!is.null(idExp)) {
  cat("_No environments were flagged for removal._")
}
```
